## Problem

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
For example: "I'm always frustrated when [X happens]."

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If you have a
specific idea for a checklist item, reference, or script change, describe it.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Context

Any additional context, references, or examples that help explain the request.
